name: Close-Grip Chin-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand palms-toward-you grip slightly narrower than shoulder width.
Pull your shoulder blades slightly down and brace your core to steady your torso.
Draw your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower your body slowly until your arms straighten back into a controlled hang.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and in line with your forearms.
Avoid swinging your legs or rounding your shoulders forward at the top.
